clipInspector.autoRemovalKeepsWhat: Auto removal keeps what the model finds and drops the rest: a person, or the one thing the picture is of. Custom removal starts from the same mask and takes corrections painted on the monitor: the smart brush keeps the whole thing it touches and the smart eraser removes it, the plain ones do exactly what you paint; Apply ends the painting. Chroma key takes out a green or blue screen instead - found by itself, or picked off the picture with the eyedropper - shadows and all, and cleans its colour off the edges; View shows the matte it makes.
clipInspector.bringsClipBroadcastLevel: Brings the clip to a broadcast level without riding the fader.
clipInspector.canvasHelp: What fills the frame where this picture doesn't reach, like the bars beside a wide shot in a tall frame. Only pictures on the main lane have one. Apply to all gives every picture on the main lane this clip's background.
clipInspector.chainRunsTopBottom: The chain runs top to bottom — reorder it with the chevrons. The eye bypasses one link without losing the values you dialled into it.
clipInspector.enhanceExplain: Restores and enlarges the picture with the enhance model, into a copy the clip then shows. Tick to turn the section on, preview a frame to judge the settings, then press Enhance to run the whole file in the background. Unticking shows the original again; the copy is kept.
clipInspector.enhancePreviewing: Running the model on the middle of the frame under the playhead…
clipInspector.enhanceShowingCopy: Showing the enhanced copy. Untick to show the original again, or change the settings and Enhance again for another copy.
clipInspector.enhanceShowingOriginal: Showing the original. Tick to show the enhanced copy again.
clipInspector.enhanceStrengthExplain: How much of the model's work is kept; the rest is the original, enlarged plainly. Lower keeps more real texture, so faces look less waxen.
clipInspector.exposureStopsRestSigned: Exposure is in stops; the rest is a signed percent of the picture as shot, and zero everywhere is the picture as shot. Double-click a label to put it back; the diamond keys the knob at the playhead.
clipInspector.layerTreatsEverythingUnder: A layer treats everything under it for as long as it runs. Trim it on the timeline to change what it covers.
clipInspector.liftsSpeechOutMix: Lifts speech out of the mix: a little presence, a little control.
clipInspector.noStillsInBin: Import a picture into the media bin to use it here.
clipInspector.nothingFoundKeepPicture: Nothing found to keep here, so the picture shows as shot. Try another subject, or custom removal.
clipInspector.nothingStarredYetHover: Nothing starred yet — hover a tile and press its star.
clipInspector.pickColour: Pick the colour off the picture
clipInspector.rateReTimesClip: Rate re-times the clip in place, so the timeline length changes with it. Trim afterwards, not before.
clipInspector.scalePositionFractionsOutp: Scale and position are fractions of the output frame, so a clip keeps its framing if the project is re-sized. The same numbers move with the box on the monitor. Width and height pull one axis beyond the scale; the edge grips on the monitor do the same.
clipInspector.soundLayerTreatsTheMix: A sound layer treats everything you hear for as long as it runs. Trim it on the timeline to change what it covers.
clipInspector.stabilizeEased: Zoomed to {0}%. Steadying every frame would take {1}%, so the shakiest moments are steadied less; raise Max zoom to steady them fully.
clipInspector.stabilizeHelp: Takes the camera's shake out. The shake is measured once, in the background, and the clip shows as shot until it is. Smoothness is how much of the camera's movement is smoothed away, Max zoom how far the picture may be enlarged to hide the moving edges, and Tripod holds the frame completely still.
clipInspector.stabilizeZoom: Zoomed to {0}% to hide the edges.

modelSettings.title: Model services
modelSettings.configurationOnly: Saving credentials and loading model lists are configuration operations. They do not read project media or start inference. Inference and tool checks require their separate buttons below.
modelSettings.reload: Reload local configuration and credential status
modelSettings.endpointScope: Changing the host, port or base path requires a credential saved for that address. Use Custom for another product or region.
modelSettings.secureOnly: Credentials are kept only in the system vault for this connection and full service address. Ordinary configuration stores references, never plaintext credentials.
modelSettings.credentialBlank: Leave the credential field empty to retain the existing credential for this exact connection and address.

modelSettings.customProduct: Choose the exact protocol, address, model and authorized credential for your service. An existing label never proves compatibility or account access.
